frame_correlation: frames within one seed are correlated; per-seed cells are reported so a stratum cannot pass on one seed's frames alone
missing_data: a frame without depth, truth, or calibration is a missing_data row and fails the audit if any stratum is empty
multiplicity: every required stratum must pass its floor; no pooling rescue
synchronization: rgb and depth share one sim_time_ns; truth is the oracle sample at the same stamp
tuning_rule: thresholds may change only from calibration-split records; evaluation records never tune
